rule: Apply only when the Eranovum Spain EVSE power class is positively established. Use 0.35 EUR/kWh up to 22 kW, 0.40 at 30 kW, 0.43 at 60 kW, 0.46 at 120 kW and 0.49 from 150 kW. Preserve station-level detailed prices when they differ from the country table. Occupancy penalties are separate from energy price and must only be applied when the station occupancy class and session timing make them applicable.
